positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description: Working as part of the Instructional Products team.

positions.title: SDE II
positions.description:
Led technical design and implementation of translation infrastructure serving Amazon teams requiring translation services, processing 10+ billion words daily across multiple machine translation engines and linguistic service providers. 

- Dynamic Assignment Feature Lead – Architected and delivered end-to-end solution enabling automatic job routing between freelance translators and external vendors based on capacity, resulting in $2M+ annualized cost savings and 75% reduction in translation costs on 110K jobs monthly. 

- Extraction Library Technical Lead – Oversaw design and delivery of core library for extracting/merging translatable content across several syntax formats (HTML, JSON, AMF, Markdown), processing 1K+ daily translation requests post-launch. Mentored 7 engineers through component design and implementation. 

- Translation Orchestration Workflow (TOW) Architect – Designed architecture for major workflow overhaul. Reduced implementation timeline by 3 developer months through strategic re-use of existing components. 

- TM Cleanup Tools Implementation – Rapidly ramped up on new technology stack to deliver translation memory management system achieving $1M annual cost avoidance. Built comprehensive test framework using Playwright. 

- Operational Excellence Champion – Led team in reducing high-severity tickets by 39% and low-severity by 32% in 2022. Eliminated 1,000+ monthly stuck jobs through improved retry logic with exponential backoff. 

- Cross-Team Technical Leadership – Influenced architectural decisions across multiple teams within Amazon Translation Services. Led weekly tech lead meetings and established team book club for continuous learning on design patterns and best practices.

positions.title: Senior Backend Engineer
positions.description:
Canopy is a venture funded startup that serves tax accountants by providing practice management tools in the cloud. The software is built on a microservices architecture using Docker and Kubernetes deployed to AWS. CI/CD pipelines are built in GitLab. The microservices are owned by Cross Functional Teams consisting of front end and backend devs, QA, design, and product management. Microservices I worked on used Java, Vert.x, RxJava, PostgreSQL, and Python.

- Developed QA tools enabling in-house tax practitioners to test tax logic accuracy, building customer trust. 

- Built backend of client e-sign experience with one-click document preparation and secure client portal. 

- Created db migration test framework for accuracy validation, performance profiling, and lock impact analysis. 

- Led developer book club to deepen team understanding of technical tools and practices.

positions.title: Senior Web and Mobile Developer
positions.description:
Built software for the janitorial industry, including tools for work orders and inspections.

I began work at CleanTelligent Software in November of 2010. I worked part time while attending school at BYU until I graduated in April of 2013 and began working full time. I was promoted to Senior in June of 2015.

- Built Selenium test framework using Grid, Page Object Pattern, and TestNG, drastically improving test coverage. 

- Implemented table sharding framework with zero downtime using PostreSQL introspection and PL/pgSQL 

- Mentored new hires and oversaw technical training programs. 

Tomcat/Spring/Java Application Server
PostgreSQL Database Server
Selenium Grid/Vagrant/Test-NG/JUnit
Adobe AIR/ActionScript/Flex/iOS and Android
C#/SOAP

positions.title: Network Operations Analyst
positions.description:
- Worked for BYU Office of IT
- Monitored servers through Nagios.
- Worked with Windows, Unix, Linux, and Novell servers.
- Replaced failed hard drives in RAID storage.
- Trained new hires.

projects.title: C#/SOAP Server
projects.description: Refactored the code for the C#/SOAP Server used for Word document generation, speeding up and simplifying the document generation process, and added logging to keep track of how the customers are using the service.

projects.title: CleanTelligent Maintenance
projects.description:
Maintained and added to core CleanTelligent applications for Calendaring, Reporting, Inspections, Work Orders, Document Generation, etc. 

Optimized Large SQL Queries, Recursive Queries, and PL/pgSQL Stored Procedures.
